scope: Two worked sequence-to-mechanism-to-route examples: the existing BUB1B research hypothesis and an explicitly synthetic TRIP13 homozygous genotype from public literature. No second patient was analyzed, and no drug response was measured.

cases.input_type: existing hypothesis reconstructed from public reference sequence
cases.genotype: Two heterozygous coding SNVs; trans hypothesis, phase unresolved
cases.sequence_checks: RefSeq translation and complete Ensembl CDS agree

c.2210T>G.nmd_limit: Positional >50 nt rule only; not a measurement of RNA decay.

c.3006T>G.nmd_limit: Positional >50 nt rule only; not a measurement of RNA decay.

cases.mechanism: BUBR1 insufficiency is supported for selected MVA1 alleles. The actual N1002K abundance/function and phase remain unmeasured.
cases.mechanism_evidence_type: Human-curated primary-source assertions, not inferred from sequence

gates.basis: Conditional on the proposed pair, the affected protein is BUBR1; selected human MVA1 mutants show abundance defects (Suijkerbuijk 2010).
Computed canonical products; protein abundance and activity remain unmeasured.
North 2014 supplies an NMN/SIRT2-to-BUBR1 bridge; Pirinen 2020 supplies niacin-to-human-muscle-NAD engagement. Joining these interventions is a hypothesis, not niacin/BUB1B rescue.

routes.phase_constraint: Resolve trans; confirmed cis retires the proposed pair.
routes.required_next_evidence: Confirm trans and an abundance-limited, functional N1002K substrate; measure niacin exposure, NAD/SIRT2 engagement, BUBR1 mediation, segregation fidelity and productive muscle output. A full-length sequence is not a functional protein measurement.

gates.basis: Computed canonical products; protein abundance and activity remain unmeasured.
No N1002K/arimoclomol rescue supplied. HSP90 dependence of selected BUBR1 mutants does not establish rescue by this medicine.

routes.phase_constraint: Resolve trans; confirmed cis retires the proposed pair.
routes.required_next_evidence: Demonstrate actual-mutant function at justified exposure before promoting proteostasis support beyond a reserve hypothesis.

gates.basis: Current proposal has only qualitative carrier-mouse phosphoprotein bands and no confirming muscle RNA result; no affected/corrected human model establishes harmful excess.
No drug or genetic-normalization experiment has measured productive output in the proposed model.

routes.phase_constraint: Resolve trans; confirmed cis retires the proposed pair.
routes.required_next_evidence: Qualify harmful excess and causal partial normalization first; then measure drug engagement, tissue output and renewal. Keep as a probe, not an automatically transferred rescue.

cases.input_type: synthetic homozygous public genotype; no patient phenotype or reads
cases.genotype: c.[1060C>T];[1060C>T] is stipulated for this example
cases.sequence_checks: RefSeq translation and complete Ensembl CDS agree

c.1060C>T.nmd_limit: Positional >50 nt rule only; not a measurement of RNA decay.

cases.mechanism: Published Arg354Ter cells lacked detectable TRIP13 and had checkpoint/segregation defects rescued by WT TRIP13; mutant rescue failed. MAD2 remodeling supplies a distinct checkpoint mechanism.
cases.mechanism_evidence_type: Human-curated primary-source assertions, not inferred from sequence

gates.basis: The sequence lesion and published genetic rescue concern TRIP13, not BUBR1. A shared checkpoint phenotype does not establish that raising BUBR1 substitutes for TRIP13.
Computed canonical products; protein abundance and activity remain unmeasured.
The bounded source set supplies no NAD/SIRT2-to-TRIP13 rescue or validated BUBR1 bypass.

routes.phase_constraint: Homozygosity is stipulated for the synthetic example, not observed here.
routes.required_next_evidence: Test TRIP13-specific correction and successful chromosome segregation as a positive control; a BUBR1 bypass would require direct evidence. Non-transfer is an evidence decision, not proof that a bypass is impossible.

gates.basis: Computed canonical products; protein abundance and activity remain unmeasured.
Published WT rescue does not show pharmacological rescue of Arg354Ter; its expressed mutant failed checkpoint rescue.

routes.phase_constraint: Homozygosity is stipulated for the synthetic example, not observed here.
routes.required_next_evidence: Any truncation-rescue or readthrough mechanism needs its own transcript, protein-function and exposure evidence. It is not the full-length missense-stabilization route transferred from BUB1B.

gates.basis: No TRIP13-genotype-specific harmful mTORC1 excess is established by the selected primary sources.
No relevant output-preserving rescue is supplied.

routes.phase_constraint: Homozygosity is stipulated for the synthetic example, not observed here.
routes.required_next_evidence: Establish a relevant causal signaling abnormality and functional rescue before nominating this downstream drug. Shared MVA labeling is insufficient.
